business_problem: Citizens Bank needed to replace batch-oriented legacy data handling so it could serve digital-first customers, stream transaction and customer data in real time, and improve fraud, compliance, and service responsiveness.
solution_summary: Citizens Bank adopted Confluent Cloud as the bank's enterprise streaming backbone to move away from batch-oriented legacy processing. The platform ingests high-volume financial transactions, account updates, customer interaction data, and business intelligence events, then makes those streams available across cloud-connected systems instead of leaving them trapped in siloed, mainframe-era workflows. Engineering can exchange data across platforms with low latency and support machine learning and AI initiatives that depend on fresh operational data. By standardizing on managed streaming rather than hand-built batch jobs, the bank can feed fraud, compliance, and digital banking experiences with real-time data, reduce errors caused by stale datasets, and expose more accurate information to customer-facing services.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Runs the bank's managed streaming backbone for financial transactions, customer data, and business intelligence flows.

data_flow: Financial transactions, account updates, customer data, and business intelligence events stream into Confluent Cloud from legacy and cloud systems, then feed customer-facing services, fraud and compliance workflows, and analytics consumers in real time.
business_outcome: Citizens Bank increased customer engagement, reduced fraud false positives, improved loan processing speed, lowered IT and operational costs, and gave internal teams a real-time foundation for compliance and AI initiatives.
metrics: 15% reduction in false positives in fraud detection
